newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late local selling interest in line with lower Japanese prices, brokers said on Friday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked down slightly today due to fresh selling after prices failed to gain ground on the yen's weakness against the U.S. dollar.

"The market was quiet and featureless this morning on lack of fresh incentives. But prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon as some speculative selling interest emerged in sympathy with weaker Japanese prices," a local broker said.
